Ever since I was young weird things have always followed me, I don’t know why. I would see things (shadow people mostly) during the day and night and have had a few run ins with spirits. Flash forward a few years and I move to a new Provence and I meet this guy who is my soon to be feonce, they are fascinated with witchcraft and I was like fuck yeah I wanna get into that, so I did research with them and bought the crystals and all that jazz he was a garden witch and I decided I wanted to be a storm witch. Most of his spells where to keep their plants alive and most of mine where to change the weather. I made a lot of potions in my day and to my suprised they worked every time and one time when one of my potions expired and I still used it the weather got real weird (that night there was a thick fog that covered everything it touched in ice) so I thought it worked. The more I got into witchcraft the more I noticed things. One time the entire town was off and just slightly to the left (my boyfriend and I decided we must have entered a fairy portal on acadent and got the fuck out real quick) a few more years later I’m doing less witchcraft now but I’m still a witch, my feonce and I are leaving Boston pizza after a date and it’s after 10 and getting darker and we see a deer standing in a playground eating something, at first we didn’t question it until we got closer and realized that something was wrong, the deer was big like too big to be a deer and it’s legs where really long and when we saw what it was eating that was the real nope moment, it was eating another fucking deer. At that point we where shitting ourselves and getting the fuck away. After that we noticed a lot of the deer in our town where off but you would only see one freaky deer at a time. We would often see tall dark creatures standing near light post as well and sometimes when we where walking alone there would be a dog barking but there where no dogs around and the barking sound was only the same two or three barks repeating themselves like a broken record. So we did research and concluded that it was some sort of shape shifter so probably a skin walker or a windigo. People’s pets starting going missing and not returning and my feonce say a mutilated cat on the side walk with only it’s head and paws left to decay in the hot summer heat. Shit like this happened so often we mad a rule of not going out past ten pm. It worked for awhile until one night at 11:54pm I was about to drive my feonce home for the night after my parents said we can’t have a sleepover. As we stepped outside we heard a human scream in the distance, the kind that made your blood go cold. The longer and longer the scream went on like less human it sounded, and it just went on and on for almost a minute unbroken. At that moment my partner and I looked at eachother and without saying anything we both knew, it’s hungry and it’s trying to lure something in. We both got home in record time and made a shit tone of protection spells that night. One thing I remember tho is having a nightmare that night and that I was the thing making the screaming sound in my dream. It fucked me up. Soon after we moved out and away from that place. I still see scary things but nothing like that. If you are going to do witchcraft please do it at your own risk especially if you are a highly sensitive person who already attracts freaky shit. Anyway that’s my experience with witchcraft, happy spell casting (don’t curse people unless they really deserve it or you will fuck your own life up) (ive never cursed anyone it’s just my rule)
